title: lespedeza × neglecta
intro: Lespedeza × neglecta, commonly known as Chinese bush clover, is a perennial legume plant native to East Asia. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its ability to lower cholesterol levels and prevent platelet aggregation. The therapeutic actions of Chinese bush clover include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-platelet activities, which contribute to its potential in preventing cardiovascular diseases and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
